definitions.explanation: The clipped form of {月曜日|げつようび}, used where the day is already understood as a day of the week — schedules, timetables, calendars, and casual speech.

examples.japanese: {月曜|げつよう}は{休|やす}みです。
{会議|かいぎ}は{月曜|げつよう}の{朝|あさ}に{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The meeting was moved to Monday morning.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{月曜|げつよう}から{金曜|きんよう}まで{営業|えいぎょう}しています。
examples.english: This shop is open from Monday through Friday.

notes:
Shortened from {月曜日|げつようび} by dropping {日|び}. The full form is the default in careful speech and writing; the short form appears where space is tight or the context is obvious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月曜|げつよう}から{金曜|きんよう}まで: from Monday to Friday
- {毎週|まいしゅう}{月曜|げつよう}: every Monday
- {月曜|げつよう}の{朝|あさ}: Monday morning
- {隔週|かくしゅう}{月曜|げつよう}: every other Monday

USAGE:
All seven days clip the same way ({火曜|かよう}, {水曜|すいよう}, {木曜|もくよう}, {金曜|きんよう}, {土曜|どよう}, {日曜|にちよう}). In tables and signs the reading is often abbreviated further to the single kanji {月|げつ}.
